about_the_game:
A new perspective on modern warfare

Hell Of War is a large-scale tactical game combining the intensity of a first-person shooter with the depth of real-time strategy.

You begin as an operator of a combat drone — the central command unit on the battlefield. Conduct reconnaissance, coordinate allied forces, call in artillery strikes, deploy minefields, and send infantry, vehicles, and drones into combat. You are the eyes, brain, and iron fist of the operation.

But when the situation escalates — drop from the sky into the fray. Switch to direct control: lead a squad of infantry, drive an armored vehicle, or manually guide a strike drone to its target.
When strategy meets action — you hold the reins.

Artillery Targeting

Mark targets with pinpoint accuracy. Set up fire barriers, support assaults, and prevent the enemy from regrouping. Artillery is your key tool for pressure and dominance.

Infantry Command

In drone mode, you assign movement routes and positions for your infantry, marking areas to capture or defend.

When you take control of an infantry commander, full tactical squad control becomes available. Issue commands: move to a location, assault enemy positions, cover allies, hold ground, or flank the enemy.

Infantry is your flexible combat force, capable of working closely with vehicles, artillery, and drones. Your tactics — their actions.

Vehicle Control

From drone view, you set movement paths, designate support positions, and assign fire zones for your armored units. The drone acts as a command hub, directing vehicles where they’re needed most.

When the situation demands precision — take direct control of any vehicle. Drive into combat, make split-second decisions, fire accurately, break through defenses, and support allied units.

Vehicles form the core of your striking force, and you choose how they operate — as part of the big strategy or as your personal tool for victory.

Drone Warfare

Your primary drone is the central command unit — spotting enemies, coordinating troops, and guiding artillery fire.
In addition, you have access to multiple strike drone types:

  • FPV drones for targeted kamikaze attacks;

  • Bombing drones with automatic or manually triggered payloads;

  • Heavy assault drones with high-damage charges for destroying vehicles and fortifications.

Drones give you mobility, surprise, and airborne power.

Key Features

• Drone command at your fingertips — scout, designate attack vectors, call artillery, deploy mines, and coordinate units in real time
• Full tactical control — issue commands to infantry, vehicles, and drones: form assault squads, flanking maneuvers, or defend key zones
• Instant unit control — take over an infantry commander, vehicle, or drone to change the tide of battle directly
• Advanced infantry tactics — assign positions via drone, give combat orders through the commander: assault, cover, maneuver
• Vehicle warfare — deploy and personally control tanks and other vehicles
• Varied strike drones — manually pilot FPV, bomb, and heavy attack drones
• Powerful fire support — coordinate artillery barrages, minefields, and airstrikes
• Intense FPS combat — brutal close quarters fights, assaults, clearing operations, and survival under fire
• Deep battlefield tactics — synchronize units, use terrain, cover, recon, and hold key areas
• A dynamic living battlefield — the frontlines shift with every decision: reinforcements, flanks, losses — all respond to your command

Your battlefield. Your strategy. Your war.

Hell Of War is more than just a war game — it's a fight where you are commander, shock trooper, and scout all in one.
Every action matters.
Every decision shapes the outcome.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 або AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti або AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400F або AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 або AMD Radeon RX 66000 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

short_description: Hell Of War is a tactical FPS with real-time strategy elements. Use a drone to plan operations, call artillery, deploy troops and vehicles. When needed, take direct control of infantry, tanks or strike drones and lead the fight yourself — from the sky or the ground.
